snippet.title: Kutha Stroom Rush - Was Coming Soon, Now Available on Steam & Itch.IO
snippet.description:
Kutha Stroom Rush is a simple electric grid simulator/builder. Build, plan, and grow out the electric grid as the city also grows. Make sure to keep the city's electric needs fulfilled, and keep watch of the electric grid's equipment from breaking down.

Kutha Stroom Rush is now available on PC!
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589250/Kutha_Stroom_Rush
Itch : https://radiantdeer.itch.io/kutha-stroom-rush

Kutha Stroom Rush is still coming soon to Google Play...!
